description: Answer a question about the code in a public GitHub repository: how something is implemented, where it lives, how it is used. The answer comes from DeepWiki, which has indexed the repository, and is named in the reply's `via` field. Can take 10 to 20 seconds.

max_result_tokens.description: Cap on the size of the reply. Default 3000, at most 6000.

question.description: What you want to know about the code.

repo.description: owner/name, for example vercel/next.js, or the repository's GitHub address.

name: stork_repo
title: Ask about a GitHub repository
